sources.title: Zonk/MK1 Fuzz - Wedge Edition | Cunningham Amps
sources.excerpt: Cunningham Amps describes the Zonk/MK1 Fuzz as a two-mode fuzz that combines the character of the Hornby Skewes Zonk Machine and Sola Sound MK1 Tone Bender. A top switch selects Zonk or MK1 mode by changing the input capacitor value, while the main controls cover Fuzz/Attack and Swell/Level. The builder states that the wedge edition uses three germanium transistors and a handmade turret-board circuit, with each transistor set auditioned for tonal response. The pedal is handmade in New Zealand.
